The area is

items.title: Calculating the Area of a Triangle

sections.normalized_html: Find the area of the triangle [MATH: \triangle ABC.]
sections.readable_text:
Find the area of the triangle [MATH: \triangle ABC.]

[IMG: /graphics/3b4d9c9c491ffbfc0029c8dc8fbdec5f]

sections.normalized_html: EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
The formula for the area of the triangle is

[MATH: \mathcal{A} = \dfrac{b \cdot h}{2},]

where [MATH: b] is a base and [MATH: h] is the corresponding height.

From the diagram, we see that the base is [MATH: b|= AB; = AH + HB; = 6 + 3; = 9] and the corresponding height is [MATH: h={CH} = 4 .]

Therefore, the area is

[MATH: A|= (b ⋅ h)/(2); = (9 ⋅ 4)/(2); = (36)/(2); = 18.]

items.title: Calculating the Area of an Isosceles Right Triangle

sections.normalized_html: What is the area of the right triangle [MATH: ABC] shown below?
sections.readable_text:
What is the area of the right triangle [MATH: ABC] shown below?

[IMG: /graphics/6e33b27de00dd277467a671bfd437fe1]

sections.normalized_html: EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
Since [MATH: m\angle{A}=m\angle{C},] we have an isosceles triangle, where [MATH: AB=BC.]

Therefore, the area of the triangle is

[MATH: A|= (1)/(2)AB ⋅ BC; = (1)/(2) ⋅ 8 ⋅ 8; = (1)/(2) ⋅ 8^{2}; = (1)/(2) ⋅ 64; = 32.]

[IMG: /graphics/da9f32aef805e352321a281de43fe6ef]

sections.normalized_html: EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
Let's consider [MATH: \triangle CDE.] We can see that [MATH: \overline{CD}] is the height corresponding to the base [MATH: \overline{DE}] and that [MATH: DE=10\textrm{ cm}.]

Since the area of [MATH: \triangle CDE] is [MATH: 25\textrm{ cm}^2,] we get

[MATH: A|= (b ⋅ h)/(2); 25|= (10 ⋅ CD)/(2); 25|= 5 ⋅ CD; CD|= 5cm.]

Now, notice that [MATH: \overline{CD}] is also the height of [MATH: \triangle ABC] corresponding to the base [MATH: \overline{AB}.]

Therefore, we find the area of [MATH: \triangle ABC] as follows:

[MATH: A|= (b ⋅ h)/(2); = (AB ⋅ CD)/(2); = (6 ⋅ 5)/(2); = 15cm^{2}.]
